findings.evidence: Roadmap lines 424–437 require every presentation to carry orientation and framing and connect framed-oriented, oriented, and unoriented knots by forgetful maps; this file defines only `UnorientedSmoothKnot` and `SmoothLink.component : Fin k → UnorientedSmoothKnot I M` (lines 67–69, 85–91).
findings.fix: Add distinct oriented and framed-oriented presentation types with forgetful maps to the weaker presentations, and make links carry the intended component structure.
findings.issue: Only unoriented embeddings are exposed; the required oriented and framed-oriented knot/link presentations and their forgetful maps are absent, so downstream orientation-sensitive invariants cannot use this API.

findings.evidence: Lines 75–80 alias `SmoothKnot` and `SmoothKnot3` to their unoriented counterparts, and lines 94–102 alias the link names in the opposite direction; roadmap lines 427–436 reject an umbrella `Knot` type and distinguish presentations by carried orientation/framing.
findings.fix: Choose the explicit unoriented names as the canonical surface for these types and delete the aliases; reserve distinct names for genuinely different oriented/framed structures.
findings.issue: `SmoothKnot`/`SmoothKnot3` and `UnorientedSmoothLink`/`UnorientedSmoothLink3` duplicate the same types under parallel names, while the unqualified knot names misleadingly suggest stronger orientation data.

summary: The public surface omits the roadmap-required oriented/framed presentations and duplicates the remaining unoriented API under ambiguous aliases.
